config.note: pi is exact (all |G|^2 pairs). Snapshots of one training run are correlated: run-level means and standard errors use the run as the unit.

nearest_homomorphism.note: nearest homomorphism by brute force over all p^n homomorphisms G -> Z_p; generator_hom = coefficients read from the exact vote mode at the n generators (the k -> infinity limit of self-correcting the generators)

finite_sample.rule: the four add/grok p=47 models of exp_horizon.py plus the add/memo model with random 30% hold-out, split seed 0, init seed 0
finite_sample.note: each repetition draws n pairs (x, y) uniformly with replacement and evaluates the real table; rmse_vs_true is against the true eps, rmse_vs_exact_hat against eps_hat(exact pi) (pure sampling error); delta_method = sqrt(pi(1-pi)/n) |d eps_hat/d pi|

protocol.definition: k_pred: smallest odd k <= 149 with exact plurality failure <= 1e-3 on the depolarizing 2-query channel at eps_hat(pi); k_needed: smallest odd k <= 149 with mean_x delta_k(x) <= 1e-3 on the exact vote channel of the network; optimistic = k_pred votes do not reach the target (k_pred < k_needed, or k_needed > 149 while k_pred <= 149)

monotonicity_check.rule: every 6th model of the list with k_needed <= 41: all odd k up to k_needed + 8
monotonicity_check.note: the search needs only that no odd k below k_needed reaches the target (n_first_k_agrees); the failure is not monotone at small k: 3 votes are worse than 1 when the vote is right less than half of the time

oracle_eps_prediction.note: k predicted from the TRUE eps with the depolarizing channel, minus k_needed

confidence.rule: add/grok models sorted by (eps, id); the first one with an uncorrectable input (all models tied at that eps with uncorrectable inputs are reported) and the two models before it in this order
confidence.note: margin = votes of the leader minus votes of the runner-up among k real votes; SC is wrong if the leader is not f(x) or the margin is 0

blind_spots.note: pasted tables: g written on a uniformly random fraction of the inputs of the base model's table (seed 20261119); SC values at the generators are the exact mode of the vote M(x+r) - M(r) over all r, and the frequency with which 65 real votes return it (1000 trials)

tables.table: base model with g pasted on 10% of inputs
base model with g pasted on 30% of inputs
base model with g pasted on 50% of inputs
base model with g pasted on 70% of inputs
base model with g pasted on 90% of inputs

zoo_generator_check.note: number of models for which the exact vote mode at every generator is the true value (strictly), i.e. self-correction at the generators names the right homomorphism

disagreement_baseline.note: add/memo, split seed 0, init seeds 0..4 (deep ensemble of 5): all 10 pairs per configuration; disagreement = Pr_x[M1(x) != M2(x)] over all inputs, and over the held-out inputs only; compared with the mean error rate of the two networks

fail_bounds_validation.note: fail_bounds vs core.plurality_fail_exact on 200 random inputs of 4 models, 9 values of k
